summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Scandi Motors website update. Backend APIs fully functional, frontend mostly working with minor navigation issues.

integration_issues.issue: Intermittent navigation issues when clicking article cards

passed_tests: Backend API Health Check - All 17 endpoints working correctly
GET /api/cars returns 6 cars with new fields (fuel_type, body_type, color, etc.)
POST /api/articles creates new article with admin token
Landing page loads with gold/yellow color scheme and Scandi Motors logo
Navigation has all required links: Каталог, Кредит и лизинг, Комиссия, Из Европы, Статьи, Контакты
/catalog page loads with search input and filter buttons (Все, Из Европы, Комиссия)
/catalog page shows all 6 cars with proper tags (ЕВРОПА, КОМИССИЯ)
Car filtering works correctly (4 European cars, 2 commission cars)
/credit page loads with info about credit and leasing (4 features, 4 steps)
/commission page loads with info about commission sales (4 benefits, 4 steps, conditions)
/europe page loads with info about European car import (4 advantages, 4 steps, 4 countries)
/articles page loads and shows 3 seeded articles
Admin panel /admin has three tabs: Автомобили, Статьи, Заявки
Admin can create/edit articles in admin panel
